title: Unit Event — The Vivid Old Tale — Episode1 Let's Look For A Hint!

meta.Episode: Episode1 — Let's Look For A Hint!
meta.Event Outline: After successfully hosting their own event for the first time, Vivid BAD SQUAD is determined to ride that wave closer to the heights of RAD WEEKEND. As they're discussing that legendary event, the members start to want to know more about Nagi, the woman who played a central role.

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Whew! I'm exhausted!
We can finally take a break...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm pretty tired too after singing so much... We even got to the park earlier than usual, and before we knew it, it was already dark out...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Nice work, everyone.
Here are your lemonades.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I made sure not to make yours too sweet, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Ah, I can feel the sour, lemony essence revitalizing my body...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Haha!
You all sound like you just finished running a marathon.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. It's rare to see all of you this tired.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Heya!
MEIKO, we came to hang out! Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
What happened to all of you?!
You guys look totally drained...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sorry, we didn't mean to make you worried. We're all just really tired after our joint practice...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Joint practice?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, we're getting ready for our next show! Arata and the others are putting this event together and we asked them if we could all practice together whenever possible.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
We had our first one today...
And they were all really good...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Mita even kept going until he literally dropped.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I believe we were all very enthusiastic about it, and it turned out to be a very good practice.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Really?! That sounds really tough, but also really fun!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes, it does.
It's wonderful to see that you and your new friends are all working well together.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We're also glad. I think that event really did let us take a small step towards surpassing RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And we have Akito to thank for the hint he gave us.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Way to go, Akito!
Woohoo!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What's with the cheering...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Also, we're nowhere near achieving that goal. We've still got a long ways to go before we can even think about surpassing that night.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Right. And figuring out what you're actually going to need to do moving forward will be no small task.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: However, just as the “atmosphere” became a hint for you all last time, you may yet come across more helpful thoughts...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hints, huh...?
Hmmmm...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Do you have something, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, I think I do!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Remember how seeing a video of RAD WEEKEND ended up being really helpful?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
What if we did that again?
Don't you think it still has more to tell us?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: For example, Akito figured out how the atmosphere was totally different from any other event after seeing that footage, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, what if you focused on something else this time? You might discover something new by zooming in on everyone's singing or how they performed!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's right! I came up with that all on my own...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm... But they've already watched it a bunch of times, right? You really think we'll find anything else in there?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The chances of that do seem low, but I'm inclined to believe that it's worth a try...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I've seen it several times myself...
But I always find myself overwhelmed by everyone's technical mastery and the quality of their performances.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
So you may be right, Rin.
Trying to see how RAD WEEKEND differed from other events may lead us to some new discoveries.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, now I understand!
It makes so much sense coming from you, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
What?
Len, what's that supposed to mean?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, relax. I'm kidding.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Alright, you two, settle down!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
So, let's give it another watch!
Would you all like to join us?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, are you sure?
Yes, since we missed our chance to last time.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
That's right!
Len and Rin kept saying how great it was while we were essentially still in the dark.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: In that case, let's make it a viewing party. Let's see... We can show it on the screen we used during that event we did the other day.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Alright, let's all help get things set up!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay, here we go.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Wow...!
She's incredible...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Powerful too!
Her singing is so overwhelming that I'm getting sucked in.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
I couldn't believe it the first time either!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yeah, I didn't think it would be this amazing...! It's sending chills down my spine!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, you guys, be quiet!

rows.Speaker: Len, Luka & KAITO
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh my...
As rambunctious as ever, I see.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, they are.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But by comparison, Kohane and the others are...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I always end up focusing on how everyone sings, but I'm gonna try to learn more about their set lists today...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (With that one line in their very first song, they turned the live house on its head, got everyone's attention and kept drawing them in...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (And they're doing a great job of transitioning between songs and keeping the crowd guessing...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But... Still...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(This Nagi person...
I can't look away from her...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(The lighting's amazing too...
It's hardly a big venue, but the lights are giving this stage a totally unique feel.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (And standing in the center is...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (How is she able to get everyone so worked up? Is it her raw singing ability...? No, wait... There's definitely something else at work here.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (It's as if everyone's energy and...something else...are swirling around her... Like she's at the center of this storm... Could this be...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Clues... Look for clues...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Argh. No, I always end up just watching it. I need to take a step back and look for clues and hints this time...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Still... RAD WEEKEND's just something else.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (My heart races every time I see it and I'm completely immersed in it before I realize what's going on...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, she really is amazing...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright, how'd you guys do...?
Find anything good?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah! Um, so...
It was really, really awesome!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, what happened to looking for clues?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, um...!
B-But I got so caught up in watching it!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha! Oh, Rin...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
But I understand how you feel.
I got really sucked in the first time too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I mean, that's why it's considered such a legendary night, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm not sure if this counts as a hint or clue, but I did notice something...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, what have you got for us?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I may be mistaken...
But something about all the performers' voices felt sad or dispirited for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sad...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes.
But it was very subtle...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
What?
Even though everyone was going totally nuts?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What if it's because my dad and his team decided to split up...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That event became their very last event and I'm guessing everyone else sort of already knew that.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, so because it was RADder's last event, everyone felt that they had to sing with everything they had?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Could that be it...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, it would sort of explain why they all sang with so much passion..

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, I'm not sure if we can conclusively say that it's the reason why this event became so extraordinary...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Speaking of singing with passion...
The way Nagi sang by herself in the beginning left a big impression on me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Also, it kind of felt like Nagi, Taiga's little sister, was at the center of this entire event...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, Kohane, you too?
I sorta felt the same way.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Same here.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: From the very first song, RAD WEEKEND's atmosphere felt way different from other events. And Nagi was the reason behind that...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I see...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We all worked together and did everything we could to approach that level, but this Nagi person achieved that all by herself... Possibly from the get-go with just that one song...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, and it wasn't just that.
She seemed to make it so everyone around her could also do their best.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: My dad and Uncle Taiga seemed pretty tense when they took the stage, but Aunt Nagi found a way to get them to relax by talking to them.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
And her power was so awesome!
I'm never gonna get tired of seeing what she did!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me... You know this Nagi person pretty well, right, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, I do.
She's been looking after me since I was really little.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I used to practice singing with my dad, Uncle Taiga and her all the time back then too... Those days were so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Um, An...?
Would you mind telling us more about how things were like back then?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? You mean when I used to practice with Aunt Nagi?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. I have a feeling that we'll understand RAD WEEKEND a lot better by learning more about Nagi.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like to hear more as well.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Nagi clearly stood at the center of RAD WEEKEND, so we certainly have much to gain by learning more about her.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Plus...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: She stood toe to toe with Ken and Taiga in terms of singing ability, so I sorta just want to know more about her personally...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I agree.
I'm interested as well.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Me too! Me too!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Aunt Nagi, huh...?
Hmm... I don't mind telling you more about her, but where do I even start...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, I know. How about that one time...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Aunt Nagi was always the absolute coolest...
